verdict.rationale: A government filing portal could plausibly offer API access with scoped credentials for bulk filers or mandataires, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows human-facing access: FranceConnect+ login, qualified e-signature certificates, dashboards and payment delegation. Nothing documents issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent. The keyless recherche-entreprises API is a different state service, not this product's capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
